correctness.rationale: Poisson thinning yields exact independent mixed-sex Bernoulli site indicators; a Markov bound ensures finite attainment. Exact log q=-aL/k+h_delta(L/k) and two complementary binomial tail terms provide coercive lower bounds. A unique scalar minimum yields the balanced sqrt(L) constant; trial comparison and exclusion of both off-scale ranges yields biased k log L/L -> delta, including optimized logarithmic failure exponents. All r>=2, fixed theta, k integer and r=1 boundary are handled. A separate stdlib checker tests exact laws and finite optimization; the asymptotic claims rest on analysis, not samples.

value.rationale: The asymptotic order of the number of sites needed to achieve redundant co-sex occupancy changes from sqrt(L) at exact sex balance to L/log L for every fixed imbalance; the r=1 benchmark differs entirely. This is a motivated structural threshold for a natural redundancy objective in mate-limited colonization, not a narrow numerical example or reparameterization. Biological interpretation is limited to mating potential, not establishment.
